features.libdbus-sys: dynamic system pkg-config; not bundled in current release
features.openssl-sys: no enabled node; cargo tree --workspace --locked --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -e features -i openssl-sys prints nothing
features.openssl-probe: pure-Rust CA location probe, not OpenSSL library

libdbus.not_lgpl: vendor/dbus/COPYING grants AFL-2.1 OR GPL-2.0-or-later. The bindings MIT/Apache license does not replace the vendored C library license.
libdbus.source_strategy: Supply entire unmodified libdbus-sys-0.2.7.crate with lockfile-verified hash, including vendor/dbus, build_vendored.rs, all original copyright headers and COPYING. No MediaAtlas source license is selected; no LGPL relinking obligation applies to the selected AFL library alternative.
